It was a family matter in the 20 mile added event here at state fair park last June. Dick Rath-
mann, Roselle, Ill. (No. 45-Braund Plywood Spl.) was doing battle with younger brother, Jim (No.
4-Kenpaul Spl.). Although Jim had won the 500 mile Indianapolis race earlier, Dick showed little re-
spect and took brother Jim. In center row Len Sutton, Portland, Ore. (No. 9-Central Excavating Co.
Spl.) and Lloyd Ruby, Houston, Texas (No. 98-Agajanian Spl.) fight for position in the 200 miler here
last August. At the right is Bob Cleberg, born in Milwaukee, lived most of his life in Rio, Wisconsin,
and now a resident of Phoenix, Arizona. At left in bottom row is Parnelli Jones, Torrance, Calif. who
will drive the Agajanian Spl. in today's 100 miler. At right is action between a couple of old pros—
Tony Bettenhausen, Tinley Park, Ill. (No. 2-Lindsey Hopkins Spl. and Rodger Ward, Indianapolis, Ind.
(No. 1-Leader Card Spl.)-in the 200 miler here last August. Both dropped out with mechanical troubles.
